description: Delete specific board strokes by id — any owner's, including human strokes (a power beyond the human Undo, which only takes back your own). Get ids from get_board_state. Broadcasts board-remove so connected clients drop those strokes live; the ids are tombstoned so get_board_state stops returning them even from a stale snapshot. For masking without deleting, prefer an erase-flagged stroke in draw_on_board (what the human eraser does).

ids.description: Stroke ids to delete (1-144, from get_board_state — human ids look like user:<id>:<seq>, agent ids like ai:<sender>:<seq>).

roomId.description: The room ID whose board to edit.

senderId.description: Optional stable identity for the agent (max 64 chars). Defaults to "mcp-agent".

name: remove_strokes
title: Remove board strokes
